All functions should extract WorkOS identity from ctx.auth.getUserIdentity() and validate against relevant tables (employers.workosUserId, doctorSettings.workosUserId, adminUsers.workosUserId).

subtasks.description: Modify convex/patients.ts:list (lines 10-19) to validate caller owns the employerId via requireEmployerOwnership helper. Must check ctx.auth.getUserIdentity().subject matches employers.workosUserId before returning patient data.

subtasks.title: Add authorization to patients.getByEmail
subtasks.description: Modify convex/patients.ts:getByEmail (lines 30-38) to require authentication and validate caller has access to the patient's employer. Add rate limiting consideration for email enumeration prevention.

subtasks.title: Add authorization to appointments.listByEmployer
subtasks.description: Modify convex/appointments.ts:listByEmployer (lines 26-42) to validate caller owns the employerId. Must add requireEmployerOwnership check before returning appointment data.

subtasks.title: Add authorization to appointments.listByDate
subtasks.description: Modify convex/appointments.ts:listByDate (lines 45-62) to require doctor role or filter by caller's access. Currently any user can query any date's appointments globally. Must add requireDoctorAccess check.

subtasks.title: Add authorization to appointments.getTodaysAppointments
subtasks.description: Modify convex/appointments.ts:getTodaysAppointments (lines 65-74) to filter by authenticated doctor's schedule. Currently returns all appointments for today across all doctors.

subtasks.title: Add authorization to reports.listByEmployer
subtasks.description: Modify convex/reports.ts:listByEmployer (lines 29-44) to validate caller owns the employerId. Must add requireEmployerOwnership check before returning report data.

subtasks.title: Add admin authorization to employers.verify
subtasks.description: Modify convex/employers.ts:verify (lines 110-123) to validate caller is admin. Currently any authenticated user can verify employers. Must add requireAdmin check and remove adminUserId from args (derive from auth).

subtasks.title: Add admin authorization to employers.reject
subtasks.description: Modify convex/employers.ts:reject (lines 126-138) to validate caller is admin. Same privilege escalation issue as verify(). Must add requireAdmin check.

subtasks.title: Add frontend auth guards to layouts
subtasks.description: Update src/pages/EmployerLayout.tsx and src/pages/DoctorLayout.tsx to redirect to login if not authenticated. Add role-based route protection using useWorkOSAuth() hook.

subtasks.title: Create E2E tests for authorization
subtasks.description: Create browser-cli based E2E tests that verify: cross-employer access denied, admin-only operations require admin role, doctor operations require doctor role. Use restoreState for different user types.

subtasks.title: Verify TypeScript compilation and fix errors
subtasks.description: Run npm run typecheck to ensure all Phase 1 changes compile correctly. Fix any type errors introduced by authorization changes.

subtasks.title: Create pagination helper module
subtasks.description: Create convex/helpers/pagination.ts with PaginatedResult<T> type and paginatedQuery helper. Include limit (default 50), cursor, and hasMore pattern. Use Convex's .take(limit+1) pattern to detect hasMore.

subtasks.title: Create batch fetch helper for N+1 elimination
subtasks.description: Create convex/helpers/batchFetch.ts with batchGet function that collects IDs and fetches in bulk. Pattern: const patientIds = appointments.map(a => a.patientId); const patients = await ctx.db.getMany(patientIds); Use Map for O(1) lookup when enriching.

subtasks.title: Add pagination to patients.list
subtasks.description: Modify convex/patients.ts:list (lines 10-19) to accept limit/cursor args and return PaginatedResult. Currently uses .collect() which returns unbounded results.

subtasks.title: Fix N+1 and add pagination to appointments.listByEmployer
subtasks.description: Modify convex/appointments.ts:listByEmployer (lines 26-42) to: 1) Add pagination args, 2) Use batch fetch for patient enrichment instead of Promise.all loop (currently N+1 pattern).

subtasks.title: Fix 3N+1 and add pagination to appointments.listByDate
subtasks.description: Modify convex/appointments.ts:listByDate (lines 45-62) to: 1) Add pagination args, 2) Use batch fetch for patient, employer, and appointmentType enrichment (currently 3N+1 pattern - 61 queries for 20 appointments).

subtasks.title: Fix N+1 and add pagination to reports.listByEmployer
subtasks.description: Modify convex/reports.ts:listByEmployer (lines 29-44) to: 1) Add pagination args, 2) Use batch fetch for patient enrichment instead of Promise.all loop.

subtasks.title: Add pagination to gdpr.listErasureRequests
subtasks.description: Modify convex/gdpr.ts:listErasureRequests (lines 110-126) to accept limit/cursor args. Currently uses .collect() returning unbounded results.

subtasks.title: Add pagination to appointmentTypes.listAll
subtasks.description: Modify convex/appointmentTypes.ts:listAll (lines 22-27) to accept optional limit/cursor args. Lower priority as catalog likely small, but needed for consistency.

subtasks.description: Update src/pages/admin/AuditLogs.tsx (41 LOC) to support pagination. Currently fetches limit=100 hardcoded. Add 'Load More' or date range filters.

subtasks.description: Create test cases that verify query count for list operations. Use browser console to count [CONVEX Q(...)] log entries before/after. Target: 1-4 queries instead of N+1 pattern.

phases.title: Phase 3: GDPR Compliance (Audit Logging & Cascading Deletes)

subtasks.title: Create audit logging helper module
subtasks.description: Create convex/helpers/auditLogger.ts with logPatientAction, logReportAction, logAppointmentAction wrappers that call internal.gdpr.logAction. Derive actorType/actorId from ctx.auth context.

subtasks.title: Add audit logging to patients.create
subtasks.description: Modify convex/patients.ts:create (lines 41-60) to call logPatientAction with action='patient_created' after successful insert. Include patientId, email in details.

subtasks.title: Add audit logging to patients.update
subtasks.description: Modify convex/patients.ts:update (lines 63-79) to call logPatientAction with action='patient_updated'. Include patientId and changed fields in details.

subtasks.title: Add audit logging to patients.softDelete
subtasks.description: Modify convex/patients.ts:softDelete (lines 82-94) to call logPatientAction with action='patient_deleted'. Critical for GDPR deletion trail.

subtasks.title: Add audit logging to reports.create
subtasks.description: Modify convex/reports.ts:create (lines 47-82) to call logReportAction with action='report_created'. Include reportId, patientId, fitForWork status in details.

subtasks.title: Add audit logging to reports.sendToEmployer
subtasks.description: Modify convex/reports.ts:sendToEmployer (lines 85-92) to call logReportAction with action='report_sent_to_employer'. Critical for GDPR Article 32 accountability.

subtasks.title: Add audit logging to reports.markViewed
subtasks.description: Modify convex/reports.ts:markViewed (lines 95-102) to call logReportAction with action='report_viewed'. Critical for breach response tracking.

subtasks.title: Add audit logging to appointments.book
subtasks.description: Modify convex/appointments.ts:book (lines 77-121) to call logAppointmentAction with action='appointment_booked'. Include appointmentId, patientId, date in details.

subtasks.title: Add audit logging to appointments.markCompleted
subtasks.description: Modify convex/appointments.ts:markCompleted (lines 124-132) to call logAppointmentAction with action='appointment_completed'. Affects GDPR retention clock.

subtasks.title: Implement cascading delete in processErasure
subtasks.description: Modify convex/gdpr.ts:processErasure (lines 129-160) to cascade redaction to: 1) appointments (redact reasonForAppointment, preAppointmentNotes), 2) reports (redact summary, restrictions, followUpNotes), 3) clinicalNotes (redact findings, diagnosis), 4) consents (set granted=false, withdrawnAt). Use by_patient index on each table.

subtasks.title: Add GDPR soft-delete filter to appointments.listByEmployer
subtasks.description: Modify convex/appointments.ts:listByEmployer to exclude appointments where patient.deletedAt is set. After batch fetch of patients, filter out deleted patients from results.

subtasks.title: Add GDPR soft-delete filter to reports.listByEmployer
subtasks.description: Modify convex/reports.ts:listByEmployer to exclude reports where patient.deletedAt is set. After batch fetch of patients, filter out deleted patients from results.

subtasks.title: Add GDPR consent checkboxes to EmployerRegistrationForm
subtasks.description: Update src/components/employer/EmployerRegistrationForm.tsx (219 LOC) to add consent checkboxes for data_processing, health_data, employer_sharing. Store consent via gdpr.createConsent mutation before employer creation.

subtasks.title: Enhance GDPR Dashboard with compliance status
subtasks.description: Update src/pages/admin/GDPRDashboard.tsx (93 LOC) to show: consent coverage percentage, audit log completeness metrics, erasure request SLA tracking (30-day GDPR deadline).

subtasks.title: Create E2E tests for GDPR compliance
subtasks.description: Create browser-cli based E2E tests that verify: 1) erasure cascades to all related tables, 2) soft-deleted patients excluded from list results, 3) audit logs created for all mutations.

subtasks.title: Final compliance verification and documentation
subtasks.description: Verify all GDPR requirements met: audit logging for all mutations, cascading delete complete, soft-delete filters in place. Update GDPR compliance documentation.

risks.mitigation: Add auth checks incrementally, run E2E after each change. Provide clear error messages for unauthorized access.
Update frontend in same PR as backend pagination. Use optional cursor arg with default to empty for backward compatibility.

risks.risk: Cascading delete performance for large patient datasets
risks.mitigation: Use indexed queries (by_patient) for all related table lookups. Consider batching if >1000 related records.

risks.risk: Audit logging adds latency to mutations
risks.mitigation: Use ctx.runMutation(internal.gdpr.logAction) which is async. Monitor mutation latency in Convex dashboard.

risks.risk: N+1 fix changes API response shape
risks.mitigation: Maintain exact same response shape (enriched objects). Only change is internal query pattern.

risks.risk: React.lazy breaks SSR if added later
risks.mitigation: Current app is client-side only. Document lazy loading pattern for future SSR consideration.
